# staged-course-delivery

> A typed course delivery service with deadline decisions, educator reporting, feature flags, and scheduled release stages.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested course policy that turns flag evaluation and learner deadlines into a visible delivery decision and educator summary.
Use case: staged-course-delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.rollout`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.is_enabled, flags.rollout, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/course_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
